newsitem.title: SPAIN: Montoro says Spain income tax to be cut from 1998.
newsitem.headline: Montoro says Spain income tax to be cut from 1998.

text.p: Spanish Economy Secretary Cristobal Montoro said on Wednesday that the government intended to cut income taxes from 1998.

"With inflation lower than economic growth, we have enough money in the next budget to finance basic social services, to lower the (public) deficit and reduce taxes from 1998," he told journalists at a conference here.
When asked whether this would include income tax, Montoro replied that it would.
As part of its election platform in 1996, the Popular Party had promised income tax cuts.
Montoro added that a parliamentary committee was currently studying ways to finance health care.
Asked whether the government would introduce taxes to finance health care he replied: "The time to raise (taxes) is over".
